name: One Church Software
shortDescription: A church management platform with people, events, giving, service planning and optional finance tools, priced by total profiles.
suitableContexts: Churches that want configurable people, workflow and service-planning tools

editorial.assessment: One Church Software has a detailed published module set and a 30-day trial, but its billing count is broader than a simple active-member total. UK churches should first confirm its international availability, payment arrangements, accounting fit and treatment of archived data.

Multi-campus teams that can validate the Core+ feature set

limitations: US-dollar pricing and total-profile billing need careful comparison

procurementVerdict.firstCheck: US-dollar pricing and total-profile billing need careful comparison

longForm.verdict: One Church Software is not a straightforward cost-per-active-member comparison: its published pricing counts all profiles, including archived and inactive records. That makes data governance—what the church keeps, merges or retires—a direct procurement issue.

decisionLens.heading: Database hygiene becomes a pricing decision.
decisionLens.text: The supplier says pricing is based on total profiles, including kids, adults, archived, active, members and guests. Before a trial, quantify the current database and define which historic records must be retained for pastoral, financial or safeguarding reasons.

sections.heading: Core, Core+ and finance
sections.question: Which capabilities are genuinely needed from day one?
paragraphs: One Church Software publishes Core and Core+ plans, with Core+ adding automation, rooms and resources, multi-campus tools, an API and training. It also lists finance-related offerings separately.

Use the 30-day trial to test a people journey, an event, a service plan and the exports needed by administrators. Treat any accounting, giving or payment decision as a separate UK due-diligence exercise.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not rely on a third-party review score. It is grounded in the supplier’s current pricing, trial and feature documentation.
themes: Total-profile pricing needs an early data audit.
The Core+ trial should be used to validate workflow and multi-campus needs, not just individual screens.
userFeedback.caveat: No conclusion about user satisfaction or UK suitability should be drawn from the absence of independent-review research here.

faq.question: Does One Church Software have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. The supplier advertises a 30-day Core+ trial with no credit card required and says plans can be changed or cancelled.

faq.question: How is One Church Software priced?
faq.answer: The supplier publishes Core and Core+ prices that vary by total profiles in the system, including active, inactive and archived records. It also lists optional add-ons.

faq.question: Can a UK church use One Church Software?
faq.answer: Ask the supplier whether it currently sells to UK churches and which feature limits apply. This profile does not establish UK payments, Gift Aid or accounting suitability.
